notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
description:
Activate Sash and Waistcoat by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters, Guide of Souls and Davvol trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}
Resolve the Davvol trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life
Repeat.
